The decision proved inspired almost immediately. In the 48th minute, just moments after his introduction, Sofus Johannesen found space in the box and clinicaly finished with his right foot to double the lead. As the game progressed, the physical nature of the contest intensified. Yellow cards were issued to Toni Fruk and Alfonso Barco for rough challenges, while Johannesen also entered the book for a foul in the 60th minute. Despite a flurry of tactical changes from both managers in the closing stages—including the introduction of Amer Gojak and Adam Gabriel —the scoreline remained unchanged. FC Midtjylland professionally saw out the final minutes to secure a significant victory on the European stage.
